label: Sauce Labs
description: Manage real devices, sessions, apps, screenshots and hosted Appium

operations.name: list_devices
operations.description: List device descriptors available to your account.

operations.name: list_device_status
operations.description: Read live device availability; public devices have aggregated states.

operations.name: create_session
operations.description: Allocate a device; poll Get Session until ACTIVE before interacting. Uses your device quota.

operations.name: list_sessions
operations.description: Read pending, active and recently closed sessions for the authenticated account.

operations.name: close_session
operations.description: Release a device session; CLOSING is an acknowledgement, not completed cleanup.

operations.name: execute_shell_command
operations.description: Execute a short Android adb shell command without the adb shell prefix.

operations.name: open_url
operations.description: Open a URL or iOS deep link on an ACTIVE device; Android uses Chrome.

operations.name: install_app
operations.description: Start a background app installation; poll List App Installations for completion.

operations.name: uninstall_app
operations.description: Uninstall the specified iOS bundle or Android package from this device.

operations.name: apply_settings
operations.description: Change orientation and optional Android locale/animations during an ACTIVE session.

operations.name: start_appium
operations.description: Start the hosted Appium server for this device session.
